unbound: NO KEY: BIND ONE IN THE OPTIONS.

items.name: TWIN GUN
items.text: TWO BARRELS IN TURN: TWICE THE RATE, THE SAME REACH.

items.name: LAUNCHER
items.text: THE NEXT STEP OF THE LAUNCHER, AS A PRISONER GIVES IT, FROM THE NEXT ROUND ON.

items.name: RADAR
items.text: MARKS THE GUNS AND TANKS OFF THE SCREEN AT ITS EDGE.
items.note: Where the loopholes were, which are off the shelves for now (docs/shop-plan.md); their code is still there, and --upgrades gives them.

items.name: SPARES
items.text: DIE AND THE LAUNCHER LOSES ONE STEP, NOT ALL OF THEM.

items.name: ARMOR
items.text: DIE AND EVERY PRISONER ABOARD JUMPS OUT ALIVE.

items.name: RAM CAGE
items.text: RAM A GUN OR A TANK AND LIVE. THE CAGE IS LOST: BUY ANOTHER.
items.note: Lost to the first ram it saves the jeep from (level3d_preview.gd, _shed_cage), and then for sale again.

items.name: NITRO
items.text: A DASH AHEAD, THROUGH THE LINE OF FIRE. RELOADS.

items.name: MINES
items.text: A MINE DROPPED BEHIND, FOR THE TANK ON YOUR TAIL.

items.name: AIRSTRIKE
items.text: WIPES OUT THE ENEMIES ON THE SCREEN FOR 2000, 4000, 8000 A CALL. NOT THE BOSS.

items.name: APS
items.title: ACTIVE PROTECTION SYSTEM
items.text: SHOOTS DOWN A MISSILE ABOUT TO HIT YOU. ONE EVERY 10 SECONDS.
items.note: The Arena: APS on its tile and the HUD, in full in the shop's words. Only of use where enemy missiles fly (docs/shop-plan.md): none on stage-0 as yet.

items.name: LIFE
items.text: ONE MORE LIFE. EACH ONE COSTS 5000 MORE THAN THE LAST.
